description: Read web pages: returns each page's main content as clean Markdown without navigation, scripts or ads (headings, lists, absolute links, tables, code blocks), plus title, description, language, canonical URL and word count; up to 100,000 characters per page. Does not get past bot walls. Paid only: up to 3 URLs per call for $0.002 USDC. Paid calls made without a payment return isError with the x402 v2 PaymentRequired object (amount in USDC atomic units, network, payTo, HTTP endpoint); retry with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Invalid input and calls where every item fails are never charged. Fetches follow robots.txt, use the User-Agent AdamHaleTools/1.0 and refuse private or internal addresses.

items.description: A public http(s) URL or bare domain (bare domain = its https:// homepage). No IP addresses, internal names or ports other than 80/443.

x402_payment.description: Optional, paid tier only: a signed x402 v2 PaymentPayload, base64 (the value an HTTP client sends as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Prefer params._meta["x402/payment"]. Never a private key or seed phrase.

name: page_to_markdown
title: Web page to clean Markdown
